skills.name: Whale Bone: Station (鲸骨·驻/鯨骨・駐)
skills.description:
At the start of the Kujira's turn, he creates a Bone Shield to protect all allies. Then uses his bone blade to attack a single target, dealing damage equal to 80% of his ATK.
If all allies are protected by Bone Shield when he tries to create the shields, his attack inflicts additional true damage equal to 10% of the target's max HP (cannot exceed 120% of his ATK).
When Kujira is in Attacking stance, the skill changes to Whale Bones: Open. ;Bone Shield (骨盾) : :Decreases damage received from crits by 40% in a single turn. Disappears when the turns ends after receiving damage from a crit.

skills.name: Whale Bone: Open (鲸骨·开/鯨骨・開)
skills.description:
Kujira attacks a single target with crushing force, dealing damage equal to 100% his ATK.
When Kujira is in Defensive stance, the skill changes to Whale Bones: Station. ;Double Crit : :When landing a crit attack, the Crit DMG is doubled.

upgrades.text: Damage increases to 125%, when this attack crits a Double Crit is dealt instead.

skills.name: Defend for Attack (以守为攻/攻守兼備)
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
When an ally is not protected by Bone Shield receives non-transferred damage, Kujira creates a Bone Shield to protect that ally and launches a counter-attack against the source of the damage.
In a single turn, if multiple allies are not protected by Bone Shield receive damage, Kujira will only create a Bone Shield to protect 1 of those allies and launch a counter-attack.
When Kujira is in Attacking stance, this skill changes to Co-op Combat.

skills.name: Scale Preparation (鱼鳞之备/魚鱗の備)
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
When in Defensive stance, Kujira increases the RES and DEF for all allies by 10% and grants them an 80% chance of gaining a Bone Shield at the end of their turn. If an ally already has a Bone Shield, their HP is restored by 15% of their lost HP instead (cannot exceed more than 120% of Kujira's ATK). ;Upon Usage :Changes Kujira's stance to Attacking and increases the move bar for all allies by 15%. This skill changes to Area Preparation. ;Bone Shield (骨盾) : :Decreases damage received from crits by 40% in a single turn. Disappears when the turns ends after receiving damage from a crit.

upgrades.text: Move bar for himself is increased to 60%.

skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
